The real number system实数系统

Is 49​ the same kind of number as 50​? One is exactly 7; the other has decimals that never end and never repeat — and that difference decides how you can work with it.49​ 和 50​ 是同一类数吗？前者正好是 7，后者的小数既不终止也不循环——这个区别决定了你能怎样处理它。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The real number system实数系统
  1. N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R; 0 is whole but not natural.N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R；0 是非负整数（W），但不是自然数。
  2. Rational = ba​ with integers a,b: decimal ends or repeats. Irrational: never ends, never repeats.有理数＝两个整数之比 ba​，小数会终止或循环；无理数的小数不终止也不循环。
  3. Simplify before classifying: 49​=7, 3−8​=−2; −4​ is not real.先化简再分类：49​=7，3−8​=−2；−4​ 不是实数。

🧗 The hard part难点 · The real number system实数系统

A decimal that repeats only after a delay「晚开始循环」的小数化分数

With digits before the repeat, 10x−x no longer cancels the tail, so you must shift twice.循环节前面还有不循环的数字时，10x−x 消不掉尾巴，要移位两次。

  1. x=0.16
  2. Line up the repeats: 100x=16.6, 10x=1.6让循环部分对齐：100x=16.6，10x=1.6
  3. Subtract: 90x=15 → x=9015​=61​相减：90x=15 → x=9015​=61​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The real number system实数系统
  • 2π​ "looks like a fraction" → rational ✗. Top must be an integer: it is irrational.2π​「长得像分数」所以是有理数 ✗。分子必须是整数，它是无理数。
  • Root sign → irrational ✗. 16​=4 is an integer.有根号就是无理数 ✗。16​=4 是整数。
🎯

cards.f: Order the sets from smallest to largest.数集从小到大怎么排？
cards.b: N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R; irrationals Q​ sit beside Q inside R.N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R；无理数 Q​ 与 Q 并列，都在 R 里。

cards.f: Decimal test for rational?用小数判断有理数？
cards.b: Terminates or repeats → rational. Never ends and never repeats → irrational.有限或循环 → 有理数；无限不循环 → 无理数。

cards.f: Is −16​ a real number?−16​ 是实数吗？
cards.b: No. Even roots of negatives are not real. But 3−64​=−4 is.不是。负数的偶次方根不是实数；但 3−64​=−4 是。

cards.f: Write 0.7 as a fraction.把 0.7 写成分数。
cards.b: 97​ (one-digit block over 9).97​（一位循环节除以 9）。

cards.f: Is 0 natural, whole, or both?0 是自然数、非负整数，还是都是？
cards.b: Whole only (in BC, N starts at 1).只是非负整数 W（BC 课本中 N 从 1 开始）。

quiz.q: Which number is irrational?下列哪个是无理数？
opts: 81​
0.12
30​
−37​
quiz.hint: Which one is a square root of a non-perfect square?哪个是非完全平方数的平方根？
quiz.ans: 30​
quiz.why: 81​=9, 0.12 repeats, −37​ is a fraction of integers. 30 is not a perfect square, so 30​ is irrational.81​=9，0.12 循环，−37​ 是整数之比。30 不是完全平方数，所以 30​ 是无理数。

quiz.q: Of the sets N,W,I,Q,Q​,R, name every one that −5 belongs to.在 N,W,I,Q,Q​,R 中，写出 −5 所属的全部数集。
quiz.hint: Negative, so not natural or whole.负数，所以不是自然数也不是非负整数。
quiz.ans: integers, rational, real (I,Q,R)整数、有理数、实数（I,Q,R）
quiz.why: −5 is an integer; every integer is rational (−5=1−5​) and real.−5 是整数；每个整数都是有理数（−5=1−5​），也是实数。

quiz.q: Write 0.45 as a fraction in lowest terms.把 0.45 写成最简分数。
quiz.hint: Two-digit block: put 45 over 99.两位循环节：45 写在 99 上。
quiz.ans: 115​
quiz.why: 100N−N=45, so N=9945​=115​.100N−N=45，N=9945​=115​。

quiz.q: Classify 3−125​ and −25​.判断 3−125​ 和 −25​ 的类别。
opts: both irrational都是无理数
both not real都不是实数
−5 (integer); not real−5（整数）；不是实数
not real; −5 (integer)不是实数；−5（整数）
quiz.hint: Odd root vs even root of a negative.负数开奇次方与开偶次方的区别。
quiz.ans: 3−125​=−5 is an integer; −25​ is not real.3−125​=−5 是整数；−25​ 不是实数。
quiz.why: (−5)3=−125, so the cube root is −5. No real number squares to −25.(−5)3=−125，所以立方根是 −5。没有实数的平方等于 −25。

quiz.q: Write 1.23 (that is 1.2333…) as a fraction.把 1.23（即 1.2333…）写成分数。
quiz.hint: Let N=1.2333…; compare 100N and 10N.设 N=1.2333…，用 100N 减 10N。
quiz.ans: 3037​
quiz.why: 100N=123.333… and 10N=12.333…100N=123.333…，10N=12.333…

quiz.q: Between which two consecutive integers does 58​ lie? Is it rational?58​ 在哪两个相邻整数之间？它是有理数吗？
quiz.hint: Find the perfect squares on either side of 58.找出 58 两边的完全平方数。
quiz.ans: Between 7 and 8; irrational.在 7 和 8 之间；无理数。
quiz.why: 49<58<64, so 7<58​<8.49<58<64，所以 7<58​<8。

quiz.q: True or false: the sum of two irrational numbers is always irrational. Test with 2​ and −2​.判断：两个无理数之和一定是无理数。用 2​ 和 −2​ 检验。
quiz.hint: One counterexample is enough.一个反例就够了。
quiz.ans: False: 2​+(−2​)=0, which is rational.错误：2​+(−2​)=0，是有理数。
quiz.why: Both are irrational, but their sum is 0, an integer. So the statement is false.两者都是无理数，但和为 0（整数），所以命题错误。

quiz.q: A designer cuts a square sign of area 50 cm2 and a circular badge with circumference 10π cm from a sheet. A classmate says: "Both measurements are exact, so the side of the square and the diameter of the circle must both be rational." Decide whether each length is rational, and explain why the classmate is wrong about at least one of them.设计师从一块板上裁出面积为 50 cm2 的正方形标牌和周长为 10π cm 的圆形徽章。同学说：「两个量都是精确值，所以正方形的边长和圆的直径都是有理数。」判断这两个长度是否有理，并说明同学至少在哪一处说错了。
quiz.hint: Find each length first: side from area, diameter from C=πd.先分别求长度：由面积求边长，由 C=πd 求直径。
quiz.ans: Side =50​=52​ cm is irrational; diameter =10 cm is rational. An exact value is not the same as a rational value.边长 =50​=52​ cm 是无理数；直径 =10 cm 是有理数。「精确」不等于「有理」。
quiz.why: Side: s=50​=52​. Since 50 is not a perfect square, 50​ is irrational.边长：s=50​=52​。50 不是完全平方数，所以 50​ 是无理数。
